angband.knowledge.monster.yellow_mold.de: It is a strange yellow growth on the dungeon floor.
angband.knowledge.monster.yeti.descripti: A large white figure covered in shaggy fur.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_black_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a darkest black hue.  Acid drips from its body.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_blue_dra: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deep blue in hue.  Sparks crackle along its length.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_gold_dra: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_green_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deep green in hue.  Foul gas seeps through its scales.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_multi_hu: It has a form that legends are made of.  Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_red_drag: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a deepest red hue.  Heat radiates from its form.
angband.knowledge.monster.young_white_dr: It has a form that legends are made of.  Its still-tender scales are a frosty white in hue.  Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.
angband.knowledge.monster.zombified_huma: It is a shambling human corpse dropping chunks of flesh behind it.
angband.knowledge.monster.zombified_kobo: It is an animated kobold corpse.  Flesh falls off in large chunks as it shambles forward.
It is a shambling orcish corpse leaving behind a trail of flesh.

To switch back to your normal shape, cast a spell or use an item command other than eat (drop, for instance).

angband.player_class.blackguard.book.dea: Gives you a powerful desire to kill, increased every time you satisfy it.  Gives you extra melee damage and extra blows, but comes with dangerous side-effects.
Attempts a melee blow that deals additional force damage when it hits, knocking the target back with a chance to stun it.
Causes a radius 13 earthquake centered around the player.
Restores STR, INT, CON, and experience at the cost of 66 HP.
angband.player_class.blackguard.book.fea: Attempts to scare every monster in line of sight for a duration dependent on player level and monster depth.  Monsters that resist fear are not affected.
Attempts a level-dependent number of melee blows against the targeted enemy.  You get 1 blow for every 15 levels.  If any of these blows damage the enemy, it will be stunned for 6 turns.
Makes any monster that can move more inclined to run toward you, and less likely to use a ranged attack (including spells and innate abilities).
Coats all your melee weapons with poison for 18+d18 turns.
With a blood-curdling cry you change into a half-man half-wolf!  In this form you move, attack, and heal faster.
angband.player_class.blackguard.book.int: Removes fear and grants you berserk strength (resistance to fear, +75 melee skill, -10 to AC, and prevents healing over time) for a level-dependent duration.
Your mind becomes too focused to be slowed, paralyzed or confused for 12+d12 turns.

You run up to 4 spaces towards targeted enemy, then perform a melee blow.  You gain an additional blow at levels 25 and 40.  If you moved, the number of blows is reduced by 25% for each space, then rounded.
Detects all monsters susceptible to fear in the immediate area, for one turn only.
Destroys an adjacent section of wall or rubble, unless it is a permanent wall.  Deals 20+1d30 damage to monsters vulnerable to rock remover.
Deals a level-dependent number of melee blows to each adjacent enemy.  At level 5 you do one blow and gain an additional blow every 15 levels (2 at 20, 3 at 35, and 4 at 50).
angband.player_class.blackguard.name: Blackguard
angband.player_class.druid.book.creature: Allows you to take the form of a great bear of the mountains, sweeping aside your enemies with your mighty paws.
Gives you the form of a statue of the Drúedain, slow but hard to hurt.
Gives you the form of one of the great eagles of Manwë.
Attempts to put to sleep each monster within line of sight.  Monsters that resist sleep are not affected.
Holds every adjacent, non-resistant monster for a level-dependent number of turns; animals are entranced for longer.
angband.player_class.druid.book.gifts_of: Causes shards to explode in a line out of the earth, striking objects and monsters.  Length of the line increases with player level.
Strikes a target from above with a lightning bolt, followed by a clap of thunder.  If targeting a direction or the target is not a passable grid in the line of sight, the player will be the target.
Grants you resistance to poison for 20+1d20 turns.
Produces a beam that destroys the first section of wall it hits, unless it is a permanent wall.  Each monster caught in the beam that is susceptible to rock remover takes 20+1d30 points of damage.
angband.player_class.druid.book.lesser_c: Confuse a single monster; more effective against animals.
Detects all living monsters in the immediate area, for one turn only.
Changes you into the shape of a quick and stealthy fox.  While shapechanged you cannot use items.
Magically renders you comfortably fed (but not satiated).
Slows down a monster; more effective against animals.
angband.player_class.druid.book.nature_c: Hastes you (+10 to speed) for a level-dependent duration.
Cures all cuts, poison, stunning and black breath, and leaves you well-nourished.
Speed up digestion to increase regeneration of hitpoints for the next 5+1d3 turns (or until hungry).
Restores all stats and experience points to maximum.

Causes a targeted 4-square radius earthquake.  Earthquakes may hurt the player, damage monsters and destroy items in some squares in the area of effect.  Artifacts will not be destroyed by this spell.  This spell has no effect when used in the town.
angband.player_class.druid.book.wild_for: Strikes every monster in line of sight with sheets of ice from above.

Shoots a swarm of 3 or 4 meteors.  Meteors will travel until hitting a wall, a monster, or reaching the target location.  Meteors will explode as a radius-1 ball that does unresistable damage to each monster in its area of effect.  If this kills the monster that blocked the path to the target location, the next meteor may continue to find another target.
Fires a gravity beam that hurts each monster in its path and has a chance of teleporting it away.
Spews plasma in a long narrow cone from the player.
Creates a radius 5 ball of fire, followed by a radius 5 earthquake, around the player.
angband.player_class.druid.name: Druid
angband.player_class.mage.book.arcane_co: Detects all traps, doors, stairs, treasure, objects and monsters in the immediate area.
Teleports you to (or near to) a square of your choice.
A door is created on each empty floor space that is directly adjacent to you.  These doors are closed, but not locked.

Fires a magic missile that always hits its target and does unresistable damage.  Sometimes a beam is fired instead that hurts each monster in its path.  The chance to get a beam goes up with your character level.
Teleports you 1 level up or 1 level down (chosen at random).  This spell may have no effect when the forced descent option is set.
Fires a short range beam of force.
angband.player_class.mage.book.attacks_a: Sprays acid in a 60-degree cone, hitting all monsters up to 10 grids away.
Shoots a bolt of frost that always hits its target.  Sometimes a beam is fired instead that hurts each monster in its path.  The chance to get a beam goes up with your character level.
Reveals an unknown rune on an object.

Adds charges to a stack of wands or staves.  Chance of success and number of charges gained increase with your level and decrease with level of wand or staff and number of charges.  A failed attempt to recharge destroys one wand or staff from the stack.
Detects all monsters in the immediate area, for one turn only.
Detects gold and senses objects in the immediate area.
angband.player_class.mage.book.first_spe: Detects all non-invisible monsters in the immediate area, for one turn only.
Creates an electrical discharge that hurts monsters and destroys vulnerable items in its path.  Length of the effect increases with player level.
Detects all traps, doors, and stairs in the immediate area.
Lights up all squares within 2 grids of the player, and hurts all light-sensitive monsters in the area of effect.  If you are in a room, the entire room will be lit up as well.

Fires a magic missile that always hits its target and does unresistable damage.  Sometimes a beam is fired instead that hurts each monster in its path.  The chance to get a beam goes up with your character level.
Teleports you randomly up to 10 squares away.
angband.player_class.mage.book.magical_d: Disables traps and destroys doors within a 1-square radius of you.
Increases spellcasting speed by 33% for 5+1d5 turns.
Grants you resistance to acid, cold, fire and lightning for 20+1d20 turns.
Turns wand or staff energy into mana; tapping stuns the player briefly.
Produces a bolt that teleports away the first monster in its path.  Distance teleported increases with player level.
Teleports you randomly within the current level.
angband.player_class.mage.book.wizards_t: Removes all monsters represented by a chosen symbol from the level.  Uniques are not affected.  You take 1d4 points of damage for every monster removed.
Shoots a radius-2 shards ball and throws around anything in the area of effect.
Shoots a radius-3 mana ball that does unresistable damage to each monster in its area of effect.
Removes all monsters within 20 squares of you.  Uniques are not affected.  You take 1d3 points of damage for every monster removed.
Shoots a radius-2 sound ball.  Apart from doing sound damage, this also has a chance to stun each monster in the area of effect.
angband.player_class.mage.name: Mage
angband.player_class.necromancer.book.co: Allows you to take control of a monster, and move it instead of yourself.  Possible actions are move, stand still, 'd'rop, 'm'agic, or 'r'elease.
Deals direct damage to a single monster, more the more damaged the monster is already, at the cost of 100 hitpoints.

Allows you to assume the form of a vampire at the cost of half your current hitpoints, than teleports you to the nearest living monster and drains a level-dependent number of hitpoints, healing and nourishing you.  When first transformed you will temporarily be able to take hitpoints from living monsters with your bite attack.
Produces a zone of disenchantment affecting the player and monsters within radius 4.
angband.player_class.necromancer.book.da: Instantly kill any monster in line-of-sight with less than four times the player's level in hitpoints, also hurting the player.  Other monsters are unharmed.
Casts a bolt which wounds, and makes spellcasting monsters less successful in casting spells.
Displaces your spirit a short distance, hurting your body as it is dragged along.
Attempts to put to sleep each evil monster within line of sight.  Monsters that resist confusion are not affected.
Targets the nearest undead monster and damages it to gain player mana.
angband.player_class.necromancer.book.de: Inflicts damage equal to four times player level on a single monster that is not undead, an elemental, a golem, or a vortex.
Teleports away each monster with a spirit within line of sight.
Darkens, maps out, and detects all objects on the complete current dungeon level.

Destroys everything in a 15-square radius circle around you.  All monsters, objects, and terrain features in the area of effect are destroyed, except stairs and permanent walls.  You will also be blinded for 10+1d10 turns, unless you have resistance to blindness or dark.  This ritual has no effect when used in the town.
Fires a chaos beam, arc or ball in the chosen direction, wakes everything in the area, and attempts to frighten everything in line of sight.
angband.player_class.necromancer.book.fe: Inflicts unresistable damage on each living monster within line of sight.
Attempts to scare a single monster for a level-dependent duration.  Monsters that resist fear are not affected.
Teleports you to the nearest living monster and drains a level-dependent number of hitpoints, healing and nourishing the player.
Changes you into the form of a warg, and gives you temporary berserk strength, at the cost of some hitpoints.
angband.player_class.necromancer.book.in: Changes you into the shape of a bat, weak but with excellent senses.  While shapechanged you cannot use items.
Darkens all squares in a level-dependent area.  If you are in a room, the entire room will be darkened as well.
Fires a bolt of nether magic.
Detects all monsters which have a spirit in the immediate area, and then maps in a region around them, increasing in size with character level.
Enables you to see invisible monsters for 24+1d24 turns.

domain.artifact.aeglin.description: Companion to Orcrist and Glamdring, and like them long lost, this sword is continually covered in tiny arcs of captive lightning that flash and dance eerily in the globes of light they create.
domain.artifact.aglarang.description: An utterly perfect, cleanly chiseled sword, with an edge that effortlessly slices rock and bone, and spells to render the wearer lithe and nimble.  It is combat incarnate.
domain.artifact.aiglos.description: The mighty spear of Gil-galad, famed as "Snow-point" in the songs of Elves.  Against it, all the foul corruptions of Sauron dashed in vain.
domain.artifact.andu_ril.description: The famed "Flame of the West", the Sword that was Broken and is forged again.  It glows with the essence of fire, its wearer is mighty in combat, and no creature of Sauron can withstand it.
domain.artifact.angrist.description: Forged by Telchar, greatest of Dwarven smiths, and used by Beren to gouge a Silmaril out of Morgoth's crown, this long chopping dagger slices through ordinary metal as easily as its name, "Iron Cleaver", suggests.
domain.artifact.anguirel.description: This black blade was forged of meteoric iron by Eöl the Dark Elf.  It is imbued with the malice of its maker; as dangerous to its wielder as it is deadly to his foes.
domain.artifact.aranru_th.description: The beautiful sword of Thingol, justly named "King's Ire".  It glistens icy enough to freeze the hearts of demons, and you feel supple and lightfooted as you clasp its hilt of gold and silver inlay.
domain.artifact.avavir.description: Holding elemental powers whose struggles turn this weapon red and purest white, this shining reaper bears within it a power of going forth and returning.
domain.artifact.barukkheled.description: A royal heirloom of the southern coast, strong in combat against the evil creatures of earth.
domain.artifact.belangil.description: A frosty dagger wreathed in a nimbus of ice with a hilt of elk horn and an edge to wound the wind.
domain.artifact.belegennon.description: This wondrous shirt of fine-linked chain shimmers before your eyes like light upon a rippling sea, the gems on it glittering like stars, the sound of the rings when shaken like the tinkle of rain in a pool.  It stands untouched amidst the fury of the elements, and blows seem strangely less powerful.
domain.artifact.belthronding.description: The great bow of Beleg Cúthalion, the most famous archer of the Elves.  Its backbone of black yew holds strings of bear sinew, and of old, only Beleg himself could draw them.
domain.artifact.bladeturner.description: An adamant suit with scales of every color.  Untrammelled powers elemental and ethereal swirl around it in an inextricably intermingled nimbus.
domain.artifact.bloodspike.description: You feel strong and firm of foot as you whip its spiked orb around and bathe it in the blood of your foes.
domain.artifact.calris.description: This sword has runes of power incused on its ornate hilt, and a single blood channel that gleams coldly blue as you grasp this mighty weapon of peril.
domain.artifact.cambeleg.description: A hero's handgear that lends great prowess in battle.
domain.artifact.camlost.description: A pair of weakening gauntlets, named after Beren, who returned to Thingol having lost to Carcharoth the hand that clasped a Silmaril.
domain.artifact.cammithrim.description: These gloves glow so brightly as to light the way for the wearer and cast magical bolts with great frequency.
domain.artifact.careth_asdriag.descripti: An heirloom of the dauntless Lords of Rhûn far to the east, and a name of dismay to creatures natural and unnatural.
domain.artifact.colannon.description: A crystal-blue cape of fine silk worn by a silent messenger of the forces of Law.  Seldom will its wearer be diverted from his mission.
domain.artifact.colluin.description: A cape worn by a hero from Valinor, a land utterly beyond the strife of Elements.
domain.artifact.crisdurian.description: A giant's weapon, with a long blade tall and straight thrusting out from a massive double-pronged hilt.  On its blade are written doomspells against both the living and undead.
domain.artifact.cubragol.description: A crossbow that grants fiery speed to its finder, and imbues its bolts with flame unquenchable.
domain.artifact.dagmor.description: A stubby blade worn by Beren, whose horn sounded of old in the glades of Brethil.
domain.artifact.dal_i_thalion.descriptio: A pair of high-laced shoes, bestowing extraordinary agility and proof against the powers of corruption and withering.
domain.artifact.deathwreaker.description: A weapon so massive it seems beyond the strength of mortals, yet you feel the might of giants within you as you heft it.  As you grip the handle of ebony and steel, coronas of fire blaze, and mighty spells to preserve magic surge around you.  You wield the Fear of Dragons and the Despair of the Undead!
domain.artifact.dethanc.description: In this dagger is bound the very force of lightning.
domain.artifact.doomcaller.description: This weapon of wrath, wrought by a desperate berserker gang, dives hungrily into the yielding flesh of your enemies.  You yourself fall under the shadow of death even as you inflict wounds that will not heal.
domain.artifact.elessar.description: A green stone, imbued with the power of Elvendom and the light of the Sun.  Those who gaze through it see the aged and infirm as young again, and its wearer brings healing after victory in battle.
domain.artifact.elvagil.description: The "Singing Blade", whose wearer can slay Orcs and Trolls in the hidden and secret places of the earth.
domain.artifact.eriril.description: The radiant golden staff of an Istar of legend, this wizard's companion grants keen sight and clear knowledge of many hidden things.
domain.artifact.evenstar.description: A plain white jewel, given by Queen Arwen to Frodo Baggins before his return to the Shire.
domain.artifact.firestar.description: A famed battle-lord of old with a head as ruddy as embers that can yet rise up in wrath.
domain.artifact.forasgil.description: A slender, tapered needle of ice that coldly grips its impaled prey.
domain.artifact.glamdring.description: This fiery, shining blade, mate to Orcrist, earned its sobriquet "Beater" from dying orcs who dared to behold hidden Gondolin.
domain.artifact.gondricam.description: Famed sea-defender of Lebennin.  A short, slightly curved chopping blade with a perfect edge shining cleanly in the sun, an object of hate to the men of Umbar who met it in combat.
domain.artifact.grond.description: The mighty Hammer of the Underworld, blackened by doomspells of shattering.  Its wielder holds the lives of all Morgoth's servants in his hand.
domain.artifact.gurthang.description: A giant sword once wielded by mighty Túrin, and an even greater dragonbane; for what worm could stand against the blade that bathed in Glaurung's blood?
domain.artifact.haradekket.description: A damascened scimitar that hefts with wondrous ease.  Famed in song as the "Sickle of Harad", and a deadly foe to the undead.
domain.artifact.hithlomir.description: Familiar with the secret ways hidden in darkness, this leather cuirass is truly more than it appears.
domain.artifact.holcolleth.description: This elven-grey mantle possesses great powers of tranquility and concealment, and grants the wearer the knowledge and understanding of the Sindar.
domain.artifact.holhenneth.description: A famous forged iron helm granting extraordinary powers of mind and awareness.
domain.artifact.lotharang.description: A superbly crafted double-bladed axe once borne by Ceruthain, commander of the Rangers of Arnor.
domain.artifact.mediator.description: A great suit of dragon hide, set with scales of many hues.  Even the mightiest wyrms of Law and Chaos fear the judgement of its wearer.
domain.artifact.mormegil.description: A foul, twisted sword with blackened spines and knobs, its very name is a curse upon the lips of Elves and Men.  It is said that it will drink the very lifeblood of its wielder.
domain.artifact.mundwine.description: A massive axe with twin razor-sharp heads, so large that it usually requires two hands to wield, with spells to ward off the elements intricately engraved upon its surface in filleted gold.
domain.artifact.nar_i_vagil.description: Named for a fiery star and set with priceless gems bearing mystic auras of protection and thought.
domain.artifact.narthanc.description: Instead of a blade, a flame seems to emerge from this dagger's hilt.
domain.artifact.narya.description: The Ring of Fire, made of gold and set with a ruby that glows like flame.  Narya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
domain.artifact.nenya.description: The Ring of Adamant, made of mithril with a pure white stone as centerpiece.  Nenya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
domain.artifact.nimloth.description: A thin spike of thrice-forged steel caps a straight silvan shaft cut from a legendary tree, and spells to break the wills of the undead and strike cold into the breasts of your enemies lay upon this perfectly balanced spear.
domain.artifact.nimthanc.description: From the hilt of this dagger springs not so much a blade as an icicle.
domain.artifact.of_amras.description: One of a pair of hunting bows once belonging to Fëanor's two youngest sons.  The bows are like and yet unlike, much as the twin brothers were.
domain.artifact.of_amrod.description: One of a pair of hunting bows once belonging to Fëanor's two youngest sons.  The bows are like and yet unlike, much as the twin brothers were.
domain.artifact.of_ana_rion.description: The great metal-bound shield of Elendil's younger son Anárion, whom even Sauron could not corrupt.
domain.artifact.of_arvedui.description: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, well padded with leather.  You feel as strong and tall as Arvedui, last king of Arnor, as you put it on.
domain.artifact.of_aule.description: The wondrous hammer of Aulë, creator of the wise Dwarven lords of old.  It bears demolishing magics that no serpent or demon can withstand, and invokes the strength of mountains to ward off the tumult of the elements.
domain.artifact.of_azagha_l.description: Azaghâl, Dwarf-king of Belegost, fell before Glaurung in the Battle of Unnumbered Tears.  With his final breath, Azaghâl plunged this blade into Glaurung's belly with such a blow that the Father of Dragons fled the field with all his kin, and was at first believed to be mortally wounded.
domain.artifact.of_balli_stonehand.descr: The twin blades of this weapon were forged in Belegost, and powerful forces to resist and endure lie ready for its next owner.
domain.artifact.of_barahir.description: Twinned serpents with eyes of emerald meet beneath a crown of flowers to form this ring, an ancient treasure of Isildur's house.
domain.artifact.of_bard.description: The great yew bow of grim-faced Bard, who shot the mightiest arrow that songs record.
domain.artifact.of_beru_thiel.descriptio: The midnight-hued steel circlet of the sorceress-queen Berúthiel.  It grants extraordinary powers of sight and awareness at a terrible physical cost.
domain.artifact.of_carlammas.description: A fiery circle of bronze, with mighty spells to ward off and banish evil.
domain.artifact.of_caspanion.description: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain.  Magics to enhance body and mind lie within, and no door can bar the wearer's path.
domain.artifact.of_celeborn.description: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend.  It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it, and mighty are its powers to protect and banish.
domain.artifact.of_celebrimbor.descripti: A metal cap forged by the greatest Noldorin smith of the Second Age, this helm serves equally well in battle or at the forge, and its enchantment will never be diminished.
domain.artifact.of_celegorm.description: This shield emblazoned with a multitude of creatures unseen for ages once protected Celegorm, Lord of Himlad; around it, a mystic balance lies, containing the conflicts of the elements.
domain.artifact.of_dor_lo_min.descriptio: The legendary Dragon-helm, forged by one of the legendary Dwarven smiths of the First Age.  The visage of mighty Glaurung forms its crest, and the mere sight of the helm, borne by Túrin Turambar, struck dread into the hearts of the servants of Morgoth.
domain.artifact.of_durin.description: The twin massive axe heads of this ancient demon's dread gleam with mithril inlay telling sagas of endurance.  The powers of Khazad-dûm protect its wielder and slay all evils found underground.
domain.artifact.of_e_owyn.description: The blade of the legendary Shieldmaiden of Rohan, who slew the foul steed of the Morgul-lord before striking down the mighty Witch-king himself, whom no mortal man could hinder.
domain.artifact.of_ea_rendil.description: A shining shield wrought for Eärendil Half-Elven, son of Tuor and Idril, "scored with runes to keep all wounds and harm from him".
domain.artifact.of_elendil.description: The shining Star of the North, a treasured heirloom of Elendil's house.
domain.artifact.of_elros.description: The shield of Elros Tar-Minyatur, founder of Númenor.  Granted long life by the Valar, even his shield became imbued with power.
domain.artifact.of_eo_l.description: The iron-shod gauntlets of the Dark Elven smith Eöl, who imbued them with magics he could channel in battle.
domain.artifact.of_eo_nwe.description: The axe of Eönwë, leader of the Hosts of the West in the War of Wrath, strikes with icy wrath at the undead, disperses hosts of evil at a word, and grants Maia-like powers of body and mind.
domain.artifact.of_erebor.description: A fine dwarven pick, good for a miner, and suitable as a weapon should the wielder ever tunnel through into a foe's stronghold.
domain.artifact.of_fe_anor.description: This wondrous pair of leather boots once sped Fëanor, creator of the Silmarils and the mightiest of the Eldar, to fulfill his hero's challenge and do battle for a Middle-Earth held in thrall.  "Dear-bought those songs shall be accounted, and yet shall be well-bought.  For the price could be no other."
domain.artifact.of_fingolfin.description: The hand-sheathing of Fingolfin, the Elven warrior-king, who dealt Morgoth seven mighty wounds and pain that will last until the end of Arda.
domain.artifact.of_fundin_bluecloak.desc: The weapon of a mighty dwarven priest, whose shade is rumoured to haunt the halls of Angband still.
domain.artifact.of_galadriel.description: A small crystal phial containing the light of Eärendil's Star.  Its light is imperishable, and near it darkness cannot endure.
domain.artifact.of_gil_galad.description: The legendary shield of Ereinion Gil-galad, who fought his way to the gates of the Dark Tower, and with whom came light even to Gorgoroth.
domain.artifact.of_gondor.description: From dying Númenor, Elendil brought this shining winged circlet, emblem of Gondor through an age of the world.
domain.artifact.of_gorlim.description: A headpiece, gaudy and barbaric, that betrayed a warrior when he most needed succor.
domain.artifact.of_gothmog.description: A great crackling Balrog's whip of flame, this weapon could bring even Ungoliant to heel.
domain.artifact.of_hammerhand.descriptio: A great helm, as steady and as distinctive as the hero of the Westdike.  Many long months was Helm Hammerhand besieged in the Hornburg, yet he strode out time and again among his foes and slew many.  Although they knew of his coming, none could stand against him.
domain.artifact.of_himring.description: In this studded cuirass of pliable leather lives the memory of unvanquished Himring, defiant fortress surrounded by the legions of Morgoth.
domain.artifact.of_hu_rin.description: Wielded by Húrin Thalion, last lord of Dor-Lómin at the Battle of Tears Unnumbered.  He stood alone, his friends and kinsmen dead about him, his axe smoking in the black blood of Gothmog's troll-guard.  No less than seventy times, as he slew his foes, did he utter his mighty war-cry: "Aurë entuluva!" - "Day shall come again!"
domain.artifact.of_ingwe.description: The ancient heirloom of Ingwë, high lord of the Vanyar, against whom nothing of evil could stand.
domain.artifact.of_isildur.description: A gleaming steel suit covering the wearer from neck to foot, with runes of warding and stability deeply engraved into its surface.
domain.artifact.of_lu_thien.description: The opaque midnight folds of this cloak, inlaid with a multitude of tiny diamonds, swirl around you, and you feel a hint, a fragment of the restorative magics of Lúthien, the most beautiful being who ever knew death.
domain.artifact.of_maedhros.description: A short thrusting blade with a large guard worn by the eldest son of Fëanor, Maedhros the Tall, who lost his right hand while escaping from Angband.
domain.artifact.of_melkor.description: A mighty, heavy black spear, once wielded by the Lord of Darkness himself as he came to Valinor in wrath.  Its envenomed bite pierced the Two Trees with wounds that would not heal.
domain.artifact.of_morgoth.description: Containing much of the power of he who once was mightiest among the Ainur, this plain iron crown has mounted upon it the two remaining Silmarils, greatest treasures of Middle-Earth.
domain.artifact.of_na_in.description: A mighty Dwarven mattock, as good for hewing orc-necks as for hewing stone.  Náin, King of the Iron Hills, brought his mattock-wielding warriors to the Battle of Azanulbizar, and no Orc could withstand them, although Náin himself fell before their lord Azog.
domain.artifact.of_nu_menor.description: A massive golden crown, set with wondrous jewels of thought and warding, once worn by the kings of ancient Númenor.
domain.artifact.of_olo_rin.description: A staff tall and sturdy, borne of old by Gandalf.  Rough-hewn runes that invoke the element of Earth stand bold upon its gnarled surface, and no creature who lives in the shadow of mountains can withstand the blows it deals.
domain.artifact.of_orome.description: The thrusting spear of wise Oromë the Vala, strong against giants of frost, and able to pierce rock or flesh with ease.
domain.artifact.of_pain.description: The massive cleaver that crowns this glaive glows blood-red and black; fell spells of annihilation swirl and dance as you swing death's myrmidon down.
domain.artifact.of_radagast.description: Made of brown leather, covered with scuff marks and dust, still these boots possess the magic of Radagast, friend of birds and nature.
domain.artifact.of_rilia.description: A large stiletto dagger that glistens with odorless poison, to which the wearer seems oddly immune.
domain.artifact.of_the_dwarves.descripti: The Nauglamír, a carcanet of gold set with a multitude of shining gems of Valinor.  The radiant Silmaril of Fëanor hangs in its midst as its crowning glory.  The sturdy spirits of Dwarvish craftsmen who labored long in mountain smithies lie within it still, and as gossamer it rests upon the bearer.
domain.artifact.of_the_eorlingas.descrip: "Forth Eorlingas!"  To the field of Celebrant, Eorl the Young came beyond hope to save beleaguered Gondor, and from his lance fled massive trolls and dire wolves.
domain.artifact.of_the_haradrim.descript: The painted shield of a chieftain of Far Harad, gaudy and barbaric.  Its wielder will fear nothing and fight with unnatural strength, but also draw attention to himself.
domain.artifact.of_the_oden.description: The narrow axe head of this weapon would pierce the armour of a very Dragon, and the designs of your enemies stand naked and revealed.
domain.artifact.of_the_rohirrim.descript: Small steel plates cover an inner layer of sturdy canvas, and both metal and cloth bear scenes of hunting and war.  As you don the armour of Eorl the Young, matchless in combat, you feel his spirit surround you.
domain.artifact.of_thengel.description: A ridged helmet made of steel and embossed with scenes of valor in fine-engraved silver.  It grants the wearer nobility and understanding.
domain.artifact.of_thingol.description: A translucent cloak of pearly grey with glowing, energized Elven runes showing calm and clear as moonlight on still water.
domain.artifact.of_thorin.description: Invoking the strength and endurance of Thorin, King under the Mountain, this little metal shield is proof against the Element of Earth.
domain.artifact.of_thorongil.description: This shimmering cloak of greens and browns was once worn by the young Aragorn, a keen-eyed captain of Rohan and Gondor, valiant on both land and sea.
domain.artifact.of_thra_in.description: A great globe seemingly filled with moonlight, the famed Heart of the Mountain.  It splinters the light that falls upon it into ten thousand sparks of white radiance shot with glints of the rainbow.
domain.artifact.of_thranduil.description: The hunting cap of King Thranduil, to whose ears come all the secrets of his forest domain.
domain.artifact.of_thro_r.description: Sturdy footwear of leather and steel as enduring as the long-suffering Dwarven king-in-exile who wore them.
domain.artifact.of_tulkas.description: The treasure of Tulkas, most fleet and wrathful of the Valar.
domain.artifact.of_tuor.description: The great cloak given to Tuor by the Dweller in the Deep.  As you wrap yourself from head to foot the words of Ulmo echo: "Thus thou shalt walk under my shadow".
domain.artifact.of_ulmo.description: The awesome weapon of the Vala Ulmo, Lord of Waters.  Mightiest of all the powers of good save Manwë himself, Ulmo laughs to scorn the dread powers of the undead, and is utterly in command of the Element of water.
domain.artifact.of_umbar.description: A great brazen arbalest with arms of gleaming steel.  It shoots quarrels with mighty power for those brave enough to risk betrayal.
domain.artifact.of_wormtongue.descriptio: A pair of running shoes once used by the treacherous Gríma son of Gálmód, the Wormtongue of Edoras.  They are aptly suited for a messenger, a servant, a spy... or a coward.
domain.artifact.of_wrath.description: A massive triple-pronged spear, so great it normally requires two hands to wield, evoking the spirit of Osse who with it pierced legions of evil and undead.
domain.artifact.orcrist.description: This coldly gleaming blade, mate to Glamdring, is called simply "Biter" by orcs who came to know its power all too well.
domain.artifact.osondir.description: Lordly and tall did Osondir stand against the wrath of giants, and clear-eyed in barrows fell, wielding a halberd glowing ruby red.
domain.artifact.pauraegen.description: A set of handgear with sparks that crackle across its knuckleguards.
domain.artifact.paurhach.description: A set of gauntlets that smoulder with an unnatural heat.
domain.artifact.paurnen.description: A set of gauntlets that give off a foul, acrid odour yet remain untarnished.
domain.artifact.paurnimmen.description: A set of handgear, freezing with unnatural cold.
domain.artifact.razorback.description: A massive suit of heavy dragon scales deeply saturated with many colors.  It throbs with angry energies, and you feel the raw elemental might of untamed Lightning as you put it on.
domain.artifact.ringil.description: The weapon of Fingolfin, High King of the Noldor; it shines like a column of ice lit by light unquenchable.  Morgoth came but unwillingly to meet it of old; his lame foot will remind him of its might should he face it again.
domain.artifact.soulkeeper.description: A suit of imperishable adamant with unconquerable strength to endure evil and disruptive magics.  It protects the life force of its wearer as nothing else can.
domain.artifact.sting.description: "I will give you a name, and I shall call you Sting."  The perfect size for Bilbo, and stamped forever by the courage he found in Mirkwood, this sturdy little blade grants the wearer combat prowess and survival abilities he did not know he had.
domain.artifact.stormwalker.description: And they hewed off Gelmir's hands and feet, and his head last, within sight of the Elves, and left him.  By ill chance there stood Gwindor of Nargothrond, the brother of Gelmir.  Now his wrath was kindled to madness, and he leapt forth on horseback, and many riders with him; and they pursued the heralds and slew them, and drove on deep into the main host.
domain.artifact.taratol.description: A great ridged mace that surrounds you with a nimbus of living lightning.  You remain utterly untouched, even as fat sparks crackle around your fingers and eyebrows.
domain.artifact.thalkettoth.description: An amazingly light tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather.  Those who wear it move with agility and assurance.
domain.artifact.the_one_ring.description: "One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them, One Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them."  Made of massive gold, and inscribed with hidden runes in the foul speech of Mordor, Isildur's Bane possesses powers so great that it inevitably twists and masters any mortal being who wears it.
domain.artifact.thunderfist.description: The long-lost weapon of Kzurin, Dwarven champion of ancient Belegost Runes of strength adorn its handle, and flames and sparks roar and crackle around its massive head.
domain.artifact.til_i_arc.description: Within this long two-handed spear dwell the spirits of frost giants and fire demons, who war forever, fettered by sorcerous binds.
domain.artifact.totila.description: A flail whose head befuddles those who stare as you whirl it round and becomes a fiery comet as you bring it down.
domain.artifact.turmil.description: Once wielded by the High Priest of Meneltarma, this great mace gleams coldly as though moonlit, and can strike equally mighty spiritual and physical blows.
domain.artifact.vilya.description: The Ring of Sapphire, made of gold with a brilliant blue gem that shines like stars.  It glitters untouchable despite all that Morgoth ever wrought.  Vilya is one of the three Rings of Power created by Celebrimbor and hidden by the Elves from Sauron.
domain.artifact.zarcuthra.description: Runes dark and deadly stand stark against the naked steel of this awesome weapon, and you feel a wrathful power of slaying and rending as you slowly approach.

domain.object.arrow.mithril_arrow.descri: It can be shot with a bow.
domain.object.arrow.seeker_arrow.descrip: It can be shot with a bow.
domain.object.bolt.bolt.description: It can be shot with a crossbow.
domain.object.bolt.mithril_bolt.descript: It can be shot with a crossbow.
domain.object.bolt.seeker_bolt.descripti: It can be shot with a crossbow.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_ethereal_sli: Fine quality elvish slippers, hard-wearing but apparently weightless.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_iron_shod_bo: A set of sturdy leather boots strengthened with iron that will last many weary miles.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_leather_boot: These are calf-high boots of flexible leather, laced from heel to calf.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_leather_sand: A set of open-topped footgear with soft calfskin lacings and a sturdy cured leather base.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_mithril_shod: The enduring dwarves make the finest footgear known, and they march in it for endless miles without wearying.
domain.object.boots.pair_of_steel_shod_b: A set of double-lined leather boots, with toes and heels reinforced with steel.
domain.object.bow.heavy_crossbow.descrip: This arbalest is so powerful it has to be reinforced with metal and requires a crank to be cocked.
domain.object.bow.light_crossbow.descrip: A mechanical bow made of wood, it is cocked to augment the strength of its wielder.
domain.object.bow.long_bow.description: As tall as a man, the longbow can drive an arrow through the heaviest armour.
domain.object.bow.short_bow.description: The traditional hunter's weapon, this light bow is easily drawn.
domain.object.bow.sling.description: A loop of leather and cords able to hurl stones or shot with tremendous velocity.
domain.object.cloak.elven_cloak.descript: A mantle made of curious silken material by the Galadrim that wondrously takes on the hues and shapes of its surroundings.
domain.object.cloak.ethereal_cloak.descr: This unearthly, completely transparent body mantle folds and drapes in iridescent patterns around you.  It weighs absolutely nothing.
domain.object.cloak.fur_cloak.descriptio: A heavy cloak made from fur and lined with leather; a luxury.
domain.object.crown.golden_crown.descrip: An elegant golden circlet, with slender spines thrusting upward.  It looks like it should be resting over the brow of a king.
domain.object.crown.iron_crown.descripti: A plain band of iron, crowned with iron spikes.  It is a tyrant's symbol.
domain.object.crown.jewel_encrusted_crow: An elaboratedly decorated crown of massive gold, studded with a rainbow of gems and jewels; worthy of a High King.
domain.object.digger.mattock.description: A digging tool with a broad horizontal blade balanced by a smaller vertical blade.  Used as a weapon of war by dwarves.
domain.object.digger.pick.description: A heavy mining tool with a long, slightly curved head that tapers to chisel points on both ends.
domain.object.dragon_armor.balance_drago: A suit of scales.  Featureless grey to casual inspection, yet a closer look reveals patterns within patterns of iridescence that throb with leashed energies bound as though by chains of adamant.
domain.object.dragon_armor.black_dragon_: A suit of utterly black scales, against which no metal or wood can rest.
domain.object.dragon_armor.blue_dragon_s: A suit of scales as blue as sapphires, emitting eerie sparks and coronas as you move about in it.
domain.object.dragon_armor.chaos_dragon_: A suit of scales that ripples and twists through every color and shape imaginable as you stare in fascination.
domain.object.dragon_armor.gold_dragon_s: A suit of scales in mirror-like gold.  You hear nothing unusual as you wear this armour, yet your ears ache as though in the midst of a cacophony.
domain.object.dragon_armor.green_dragon_: A suit of scales, glistening in sickly green, out from which falls the skeleton of a rat who touched it and died in agony.
domain.object.dragon_armor.law_dragon_sc: A suit of scales in stern blue and silver.  You feel the slightest tremor as you touch it, like massed trumpets heard and cyclones felt from afar.
domain.object.dragon_armor.multi_hued_dr: A suit of scales that throbs with angry energies; it takes all your energy to master the Elements fighting an endless war trapped inside.
domain.object.dragon_armor.power_dragon_: A suit with scales of every color, surrounded in a nimbus of perfectly untrammelled yet inextricably intermingled and utterly mastered powers elemental and ethereal.
domain.object.dragon_armor.red_dragon_sc: A suit of scales, with all the reds of every fire ever lit.  The scar tissue from an old burn aches as you put this armour on.
domain.object.dragon_armor.shining_drago: A suit of scales shining like a beacon of Light even as it greedily sucks the energy away from everything that glows into Dark insatiate.
domain.object.dragon_armor.white_dragon_: A suit of scales, coldly gleaming in frosty white.  A shiver runs down through your spine even as you look at it.
domain.object.flask.flask_of_oil.descrip: It can be used to fuel a lantern with 7500 turns of light, up to a maximum of 15000 turns of light.  When thrown, it is considered lit, so it does more than nominal damage (which occurs even against creatures resistant to fire).
domain.object.food.draught_of_the_ents.d: This looks like pure water, but its scent reminds you of the smell of a distant wood borne from afar by a cool breeze at night.
domain.object.food.handful_of_dried_frui: Fruit roughly chopped and sun-dried, prepared as marching rations for the rangers of Ithilien.
domain.object.food.hard_biscuit.descript: A filling if tooth-breaking biscuit made mostly of rye.
domain.object.food.honey_cake.descriptio: The Beornings are renowned as the best bakers among men, and their honey-cakes are deservedly prized.  Made of wheat flour with nuts and honey and twice baked, they will sustain you through a long march.
domain.object.food.piece_of_elvish_waybr: Food of the elves is always good; their waybread is no exception.  These thin cakes are wrapped in leaves and keep their tastiness for months.
domain.object.food.pint_of_fine_wine.des: A fine way to wash down some otherwise unappetising rations.
domain.object.food.pint_of_fine_wine.eff: That tastes great!  A fine vintage.
domain.object.food.ration_of_food.descri: This nutritious but fairly bland food, called cram by the Lake-men who make it is familiar to anyone contemplating long journeys.  It is sustaining, but very uninteresting except as a chewing exercise.
domain.object.food.scrap_of_flesh.descri: A grey-looking piece of dried flesh of you dare not guess what creature.  You would have to be desperate to eat this.
domain.object.food.sip_of_miruvor.descri: Just a little of this warm and fragrant liquor gives you fresh hope and vigour.
domain.object.food.slice_of_meat.descrip: A thick slice of pork, salted to keep it from spoiling.  It is very filling.
domain.object.food.slime_mold.descriptio: A strange fungal growth, prone to moving if not observed.  Not very tasty but quite filling.
domain.object.food.swig_of_orcish_liquor: This is a dirty brown color; you don't trust it.
domain.object.gloves.set_of_alchemist_s_: Highly protective gloves designed for an alchemist's elemental magics.
domain.object.gloves.set_of_caestus.desc: An ancient battle glove designed for hand-to-hand fighting.  Its layered leather thongs are enhanced for combat by bloody-looking spikes.
domain.object.gloves.set_of_gauntlets.de: A set of gloves that completely covers the hand and wrist in steel plating.
domain.object.gloves.set_of_leather_glov: Leather hand protection, with an open palm for gripping weapons.
domain.object.gloves.set_of_mithril_gaun: A set of gauntlets wrought of light, shining mithril.
domain.object.hafted.ball_and_chain.desc: A weighty iron ball, suspended by a chain from a sturdy oaken handle.
domain.object.hafted.flail.description: Two heavy bars of wood connected by a short link of chain, capable of delivering crushing blows.
domain.object.hafted.great_hammer.descri: A mighty hammer with a massive head designed to crush and stun.
domain.object.hafted.lead_filled_mace.de: A heavy war club topped with a mass of lead-filled steel, capable of landing crushing blows.
A giant's weapon, enchanted with shattering power that breaks bones, bodies, and spirit.
domain.object.hafted.mace.description: A war club with an iron head, usually flanged or spiked.
domain.object.hafted.maul.description: A long-handled hammer with a heavy head.
domain.object.hafted.morning_star.descri: A sturdy wooden pole connected by a chain to a ball of steel, which often has projecting spikes.
domain.object.hafted.quarterstaff.descri: Six feet of oak which can be wielded in both hands to give a drubbing or block one.
domain.object.hafted.throwing_hammer.des: A short-handled iron hammer that can strike hard when thrown.
domain.object.hafted.two_handed_great_fl: Two great bars of wood connected by a massive chain, needing two hands to properly wield.
domain.object.hafted.war_hammer.descript: A mallet with a tapered head and a long handle.
domain.object.hafted.whip.description: A heavy whip, this thick coil is thrown from the shoulder and can knock down a large man.
domain.object.hard_armor.adamantite_plat: An exquisite suit of nearly impenetrable adamantite.
domain.object.hard_armor.augmented_chain: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain, all over a layer of heavy padding.
A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, reinforced around the shoulders with segmented plates of steel, all over a layer of heavy padding.
domain.object.hard_armor.chain_mail.desc: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, well padded with leather.
domain.object.hard_armor.full_plate_armo: A full suit of carefully fitted plates, with hinged joints backed by chain, and light padding underneath.
domain.object.hard_armor.metal_brigandin: A stiff suit of armour composed of small metal plates sewn to an inner layer of heavy canvas, and covered with a second layer of cloth.
domain.object.hard_armor.metal_lamellar_: This unusual armour is a surprisingly light suit of laced and overlapping metal plates.
domain.object.hard_armor.metal_scale_mai: A heavy shirt of overlapping steel scales backed by leather, with matching skirt and sleeves.
domain.object.hard_armor.mithril_chain_m: This wondrous suit of fine-linked chain shimmers as though of pure silver.
domain.object.hard_armor.mithril_plate_m: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend.  It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it.
domain.object.hard_armor.partial_plate_a: A steel corselet and vambraces over a skirt and leggings of chain.
domain.object.hard_armor.ribbed_plate_ar: A full suit of finely fitted metal armour consisting of steel plates with reinforced ridging.
domain.object.helm.hard_leather_cap.desc: A padded skullcap of boiled leather.
domain.object.helm.iron_helm.description: A mighty helmet of heavy iron, completely enclosing the head.
domain.object.helm.metal_cap.description: A pot-helm of steel that protects the skull.
domain.object.helm.steel_helm.descriptio: This great helm covers the head and shoulders with plates of steel and a curtain of mail.
domain.object.mushroom.purging.descripti: It makes you very hungry but otherwise healthy.
domain.object.mushroom.shadows.descripti: It makes you very stealthy for a short while.
domain.object.mushroom.sprinting.descrip: It hastes you for a while, but then makes you slower for a while afterward.
domain.object.mushroom.stoneskin.descrip: Its poison turns your skin to stone, albeit briefly.
domain.object.mushroom.terror.descriptio: It allows you to run for your life.
domain.object.polearm.awl_pike.descripti: A more robust version of the basic polearm, with a double-edged knife mounted on a sturdy shaft.  It cannot be thrown effectively, but offers some protection to the wielder.
domain.object.polearm.battle_axe.descrip: A double-bladed axe.  Very popular among Dwarves.
domain.object.polearm.beaked_axe.descrip: A narrow axe head opposed by a crow's beak for penetrating armour.
domain.object.polearm.broad_axe.descript: A simple, single-bladed war axe capable of chopping though limbs or armour.
domain.object.polearm.glaive.description: A reinforced wooden pole eight feet long, topped by a massive knife blade that can be used to thrust or chop.
domain.object.polearm.great_axe.descript: An enormous two-handed battle axe, carried by Dwarven champions, who compete to see who can cleave the most orc heads.
domain.object.polearm.halberd.descriptio: The most successful of the polearms, the halberd has a long haft mounted with a heavy axe blade and opposing spike, and topped by a thrusting spine.
domain.object.polearm.lance.description: A massive, tapered spear used primarily from horseback.
domain.object.polearm.lochaber_axe.descr: A long shaft with a long narrow blade.
domain.object.polearm.lucerne_hammer.des: A long pole with a three- or four-pronged head balanced by a long spike.
domain.object.polearm.pike.description: A fifteen foot spear, requiring two hands to wield, principally used in infantry formations.
A reaper's weapon, the long blade almost hums in anticipation of the blood it will spill.
domain.object.polearm.scythe.description: The long crescent blade stands out from the handle of this polearm, and it is swung with two hands to harvest grain or blood.
domain.object.polearm.spear.description: The basic polearm, with a double-edged knife mounted on a light shaft.  This weapon can be thrown effectively.
domain.object.polearm.throwing_axe.descr: A short-handled hatchet, balanced for throwing.  A classic skirmisher's weapon.
domain.object.polearm.trident.descriptio: A three-pronged spear, originally for catching fish.
domain.object.potion.life.effect_message: You feel life flow through your body!
domain.object.ring.slaying.description: It boosts your to-hit and to-dam values.
domain.object.rod.light.visible_message: A line of shimmering blue light appears.
domain.object.scroll.aggravate_monster.e: There is a high pitched humming noise.
domain.object.scroll.trap_creation.effec: You hear a low-pitched whistling sound.
domain.object.shield.knight_s_shield.des: A kite-shaped shield with rounded corners that covers the wearer from chest to toe, emblazoned with heraldic symbols.
An oval shield of wood covered by leather and rimmed with metal.  A large iron shield boss offers excellent hand protection.
domain.object.shield.leather_shield.desc: A large oval shield made of layered wooden strips with a thick leather covering.
domain.object.shield.mithril_shield.desc: A shield of purest white, made of mithril.
A round shield of wood reinforced with metal rims and central disk.
domain.object.shield.wicker_shield.descr: A light circular frame of wood surrounding fine-grained wickerwork.
domain.object.shot.iron_shot.description: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
domain.object.shot.mithril_shot.descript: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
domain.object.shot.rounded_pebble.descri: It can be shot with a sling or thrown.
domain.object.soft_armor.hard_leather_ar: A boiled leather cuirass and shoulder plates.
domain.object.soft_armor.leather_scale_m: A tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather.
domain.object.soft_armor.robe.descriptio: A practical garment of thick wool or velvet, draping from neck to heels.
domain.object.soft_armor.soft_leather_ar: A cuirass of pliable leather, with a thicker leather jack.
domain.object.soft_armor.studded_leather: A cuirass of pliable leather studded with metal rivets.

store.welcome.hint.acid_hits_armor_less_: If acid hits your armor, you take less damage from it.
store.welcome.hint.acid_water_hounds_vor: Acid can destroy your stuff - watch out for water hounds and water vortices.
store.welcome.hint.acquirement_better_de: Acquirement scrolls produce better items if you read them deeper down.
store.welcome.hint.bad_items_few_magic_c: Many items are bad, but few are cursed to the point of needing magic.
store.welcome.hint.bad_situation_inspect: If you're in a bad situation, take a breather and "I"nspect all your gear.
store.welcome.hint.basic_element_breath_: Monsters that breathe fire, acid, electricity, or cold can deal big damage.
store.welcome.hint.basic_resistance_one_: Resistances cut damage to 1/3rd for the four basic elements.
store.welcome.hint.bigger_weapon_not_alw: A bigger weapon isn't always better - check your damage using 'I'nspect
store.welcome.hint.blackguard_open_wound: Blackguards can use Rings of Open Wounds without slowing their recovery.
store.welcome.hint.blindness_disables_po: Even the most powerful characters can be made useless by blindness.
store.welcome.hint.buy_light_wounds_befo: Buy at least one potion of cure light wounds before you enter the dungeon.
store.welcome.hint.buy_phase_door_before: Buy at least one scroll of phase door before you enter the dungeon.
store.welcome.hint.cold_destroys_potions: Cold damage can destroy potions in your inventory.
store.welcome.hint.combine_cold_resistan: You can combine equipment of Resist Cold and a potion of the same name.
store.welcome.hint.combine_fire_resistan: You can combine equipment of Resist Fire and a potion of the same name.
store.welcome.hint.combine_poison_resist: You can combine equipment of Resist Poison and a potion of the same name.
store.welcome.hint.confused_monster_cast: Confused monsters cannot cast spells reliably and may misstep.
store.welcome.hint.confusion_disables_po: Even the most powerful characters can be made useless by confusion.
store.welcome.hint.constitution_keeps_al: Never underestimate the value of constitution. Hitpoints keep you alive.
store.welcome.hint.critical_wounds_cure_: Cure Critical Wounds potions will cure blindness and confusion; carry lots.
store.welcome.hint.curing_cuts_stun_pois: Curing potions and spells can reduce or eliminate cuts, stunning and poison.
store.welcome.hint.curing_food_emergency: If you're in extreme need of food, curing potions might do you good.
store.welcome.hint.death_passes_monster_: When a character dies, memories of monsters she has fought are passed on.
store.welcome.hint.desperate_level_telep: In truly desperate times, use Teleport Level or Destruction to escape.
store.welcome.hint.do_not_fear_retreat: Never be too afraid to run away.
store.welcome.hint.do_not_underestimate_: Never underestimate monsters you haven't fought before.
store.welcome.hint.drain_charges_heals_m: Drain charge attacks remove charges from your items and heal the monster!
store.welcome.hint.electricity_destroys_: Electrical damage can destroy wands, rods and rings in your inventory.
store.welcome.hint.empty_devices_sell_we: Wands and staves sell for a good price even with 0 charges.
store.welcome.hint.equipment_same_resist: Identical resistances on different pieces of equipment do not stack.
store.welcome.hint.escape_blind_confused: Always carry around an escape that you can use while blind and confused.
store.welcome.hint.excess_stun_knockout: Too much stunning will knock you out! This is to be avoided if possible.
store.welcome.hint.explore_with_escape: Never go exploring without an escape option.
store.welcome.hint.extra_windows_informa: Can't keep track of all the information on the screen? Add extra windows.
store.welcome.hint.fire_destroys_scroll_: Fire damage can destroy scrolls, books, and staves in your inventory.
store.welcome.hint.first_move_entering_l: You always get the first move when entering a level.
store.welcome.hint.food_indicator: The food indicator at the bottom of the screen shows how well fed you are.
store.welcome.hint.heavy_loot_slows: Under great weights of loot, you'll be less quick of foot.
store.welcome.hint.held_monster_no_actio: Held monsters will take no action until it wears off or they take damage.
store.welcome.hint.heroism_berserk_preve: Potions of Heroism or Berserk Strength will protect you from being scared.
store.welcome.hint.higher_resistance_red: Resistance to higher elements protects you from 33% to 50% of the damage.
store.welcome.hint.hitpoint_warning_opti: Be sure to set your hitpoint warning in the options menu ('=').
store.welcome.hint.hold_life_not_all_dra: Hold life will not block all experience drain, just most of it.
store.welcome.hint.immunity_prevents_inv: Immunity to an element prevents inventory destruction from that element.
store.welcome.hint.inscription_confirm_a: Inscribe an item with "!*" to get confirmation before doing anything to it.
store.welcome.hint.inscription_confirm_d: Inscribe an item with "!k" to get confirmation before destroying it.
Inscribe an item with "!d" to get confirmation before dropping it.
store.welcome.hint.inscription_confirm_s: Inscribe an item with "!s" to get confirmation before selling it.
store.welcome.hint.inscription_confirm_t: Inscribe an item with "!v" to get confirmation before throwing it.
store.welcome.hint.inspect_command_detai: You can use the 'I' command to inspect items and get details on them.
store.welcome.hint.inspect_race_class_ab: Inspect your racial and class abilities with the S command.
store.welcome.hint.inventory_only_immuni: The only way to protect your inventory from damage is through immunities.
store.welcome.hint.light_meter_radius: The light meter at the bottom of the screen shows your light radius.
store.welcome.hint.linger_spawns_awake_m: Staying on a level too long can cause awake random monsters to spawn.
store.welcome.hint.many_heavy_weapons_un: Walking around with lots of heavy weapons is not necessarily a good idea.
store.welcome.hint.monster_hp_increases_: The more hitpoints a monster has, the more damage its breath will do.
store.welcome.hint.never_invincible: You're never invincible. Never forget that.
store.welcome.hint.never_teleport_into_v: You can never teleport into a vault, even if you're already standing in it.
store.welcome.hint.nexus_four_effects: Nexus attacks can teleport to, teleport away, teleport level, or swap stats.
store.welcome.hint.nexus_swaps_stats_war: Nexus attacks can swap your stats. Smart, weak warriors don't do well.
store.welcome.hint.oil_flask_throw_early: Flasks of oil make a good throwing weapon early on.
store.welcome.hint.options_customize: Use '=' to check out the options and customize your game.
store.welcome.hint.phase_door_open_room_: In open rooms Phase Door may well keep you in the line of fire.
store.welcome.hint.phase_door_suitable_t: Phase door is a good escape if the terrain is appropriate.
store.welcome.hint.probe_unknown_monster: If you don't know what a monster can do, use a rod of probing on it.
store.welcome.hint.probing_always_useful: Probing an enemy to learn its abilities is always useful.
store.welcome.hint.quiver_mixed_ammo_for: Quivers can hold different types of ammo in one inventory slot (max. 40).
store.welcome.hint.quiver_over_forty_slo: If you have more than 40 items in your quiver, it will take up more slots.
store.welcome.hint.recall_dungeon_return: Word of Recall will send you to and from the dungeon.
store.welcome.hint.regeneration_hp_mana: Regeneration improves your recovery of both hitpoints and mana.
store.welcome.hint.regeneration_hunger_f: Regeneration makes you hungry more quickly.
store.welcome.hint.resist_blind_confused: Finding a way to resist blindness and confusion is critical to survival.
store.welcome.hint.retreat_live_another_: He who fights and runs away lives to fight another day.
store.welcome.hint.same_type_speed_varie: Even among the same type, some enemies will be faster or slower than others.
store.welcome.hint.scared_monster_corner: Scared monsters suffer penalties and may freeze in terror if cornered!
store.welcome.hint.shape_inspect_resume_: When shapechanged inspect items with I. Resume your shape with m or p.
store.welcome.hint.spare_town_spellbooks: Carry around extra copies of town spellbooks in case one gets burned.
store.welcome.hint.speed_ten_twice_norma: +10 speed means you move twice as fast as normal.
store.welcome.hint.staff_usable_blind_co: Staves can be used even when confused and blinded.
store.welcome.hint.stealth_sleeping_not_: Stealth is very helpful against sleeping monsters but not against alert ones.
store.welcome.hint.store_no_buy_birth_op: If stores will not buy your items, check your birth options.
store.welcome.hint.store_stock_changes: The stores change their stock every so often.
store.welcome.hint.stunned_monster_damag: Stunned monsters deal less damage in melee and sometimes miss a turn.
store.welcome.hint.subwindow_messages_mo: You can use subwindows to display messages, monsters, items and more.
store.welcome.hint.swap_resistance_items: You don't have to cover every resist all the time - carry swap items.
store.welcome.hint.teleported_enemy_late: If you teleport away a tough monster, beware of teleporting afterwards!
store.welcome.hint.throw_weapon_inscript: Try inscribing thrown weapons, "@v0" for example.
store.welcome.hint.time_not_mitigated_su: Time attacks are not mitigated by sustains.
store.welcome.hint.use_resources_to_surv: Don't worry about using up your potions, wands, and staves to stay alive.
store.welcome.hint.vault_teleport_always: In a vault, any form of teleportation will always teleport you outside.
store.welcome.hint.wake_sleepers_melee_d: Melee attacks, damage, and some effects will wake sleeping monsters.
store.welcome.hint.wake_sleepers_sight_h: Time spent within sight or hearing range will eventually wake sleepers.
store.welcome.hint.wall_monster_melee_al: You can attack a monster in a wall with your melee weapon.
store.welcome.hint.wall_monster_ranged_a: You cannot cast spells or fire missiles at monsters in walls, but they can.
store.welcome.hint.watch_enemy_movement: Pay attention to how your enemies move - some are erratic, some can blink.
store.welcome.hint.well_fed_hp_recovery: The better fed you are, the faster you recover hitpoints.
store.welcome.hint.wounded_breath_weaker: Monsters' breath weapons grow less dangerous as they lose hitpoints.
store.welcome.hint.wounded_spells_same_s: A wounded enemy's spells are as strong as a healthy one's.
